notDerivable.material: L-08 (polycarbonate against polycarbonate) needs a material per part and colour. LDraw carries no material data at all -- this needs a BrickLink or Rebrickable join and cannot come from this library.
notDerivable.travelStop: L-06 (press-fitting an element with no travel stop) needs to know whether a bore bottoms out. The shadow library records a bore's radius and whether it is capped, not how deep the shank may travel before it stops.
notDerivable.slopeAngle: T-01 already records that slope part NAMES are systematically wrong. Measuring a real slope angle needs the part's mesh, not its header or its connection points.
